D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Emanuel Cleaver leads by 44.8 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 105,428 votes; a one point swing is about 1,176 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +36.4 and D +52.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$1.1M cash against $18K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
